[[Onyx Gemstone]]s are one of the rewards for defeating a dungeon in [[Guild Wars Eye of the North]]. They are one of the required materials needed to craft [[Destroyer Weapons]], which are crafted by [[Balthor Coalforge]] in the [[Slavers' Exile]] dungeon.

==Acquisition==
*[[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from [[:Category:Contains onyx|certain items]] (rare chance).
*No [[creature]]s currently appear to [[drop]] Onyx Gemstones. 
*[[Core]]
**Always drops from the [[Chest of Woe]]
**Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s
*[[Factions]]
**As a quest reward from [[Warning the Angchu]] and [[Warning the Angchu (Hard mode)]]
*[[Eye of the North]]
**Possible drop from [[Dungeon Chest]]s
**Possible drop from [[Hidden Treasure]]s revealed with [[Light of Deldrimor]]
**As a quest reward from [[In the Service of Revenge]]

==Trivia==
*[[Diamond]], Onyx Gemstone, and [[Spiritwood Plank]] are the only [[crafting material]]s that cannot be used to craft [[armor]].
*[[wikipedia:Onyx|Onyx]] is a form of quartz with a texture of tiny crystals. The name comes from the Greek and means "claw" or "fingernail".
*The art for Onyx Gemstones was previously used as the icon for the [[Obsidian Shard]] prior to the [[Game updates/20050629|June 29, 2005 update]].
*Prior to the [[Game updates/20070823|August 23, 2007 update]], Onyx Gemstones had no use, no drop locations and no [[storage]] slot, but could be obtained from the rare materials trader (when in stock).
